text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests focus on small, individual pieces of code, such as a single function. Integration tests ensure that different parts of the system work together correctly when combined. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally improve the code. This method encourages better design and fewer bugs. Regularly running tests gives developers confidence to make changes or add new features. They know that if something breaks, the tests will quickly signal the problem. This results in higher-quality software and less stress for the whole team.
